main_question: 在有限交互下，建立与实际能力匹配、且能支持任务组合的技能契约。
experiment_question: 在相同物理执行经验下，视觉证据回看能否减少错误的契约更新（错误收紧/错误接受），而不只是提高视觉问答准确率。
scope: offline_synthetic_visibility_pilot; no training; no VLM online call; no physical execution; mechanism check before real VLM/physical integration
notes: The visibility model and per-episode predicate truth are injected ground truth for a controlled mechanism check; they are NOT claims about physically self-consistent scenes.
The judge sees only the readout of the frames it is given. The oracle truth used for scoring is never shown to any method.
Method C selects frames to inspect using the frozen visibility index (which stage shows which predicate); this isolates the evidence-supply factor. Selecting frames is free of answer leakage.
readout_noise=0.0 isolates evidence supply; raise it later to test robustness, never as a way to tune the headline comparison.
